title: riley-owens-notes-to-self-2026-03-04
content:
Notes to self - Wed 2026-03-04

Top of mind / today
- 9:30 sync w/ Maya (plan autoscaler experiments) — bring current metric viz + sample traces.
- finish quick perf run: batch_size sweep for quantized gpt-medium (seq_len 512). aim to reduce p50 by 10% without >5% cost bump.
- follow up with infra on GPU driver mismatch on ded-01 (ticket JIRA-4521).

Quick wins / small TODOs
- [ ] Add benchmark script to run-bench harness: --quant=8 --cache-prefix=true (reference: confluence PLAT: kv-cache tuning).
- [ ] Post initial perf numbers to #eng-benchmarks slack thread 
- [ ] Update PR description for pr/789 with new perf plots + run commands.

Blockers / questions
- ded-01 still shows CUDA 11.8 vs 12.1 on staging nodes. Need infra to coordinate kernel update window. Ask SRE for maintenance window Fri PM.
- Redis eviction spikes when KV cache warm-up hits concurrent clients. Might need admission control or pre-warm job. Note: check old notes from Dec '25.

Follow-ups (people)
- Maya: confirm autoscaler target ranges + expected cost model by EOD.
- Avery: can you try the new quantized weights on your local with batch 8? share any hallucination/regression notes.
- Ops (Samira): request maintenance window for ded-01 kernel update; link to JIRA-4521.

Meeting prep (9:30)
- bring TS: p50/p95 p99 for last 24h, breakdown by model (gpt-medium, gpt-large-v2), error rate, queue lengths.
- 2 short slides: current hypothesis / experiment plan / what we need from Ops.

Personal / errands (not work-blocking)
- dentist appt 2026-03-09 10am — book with Dr. Lee (email).
- buy groceries: milk, eggs, sourdough, spinach.
- pick up contact lens order from Walgreens by Fri.

Brain dump / fragments (keep for later)
- Could try staggered prefix caching: cache hot prefixes in memory on staging for 10m, evict LRU > 10m. Maybe reduces Redis eviction bursts.
- Consider quantization-aware kernel selection: if sequence < 256 use kernel A, else fallback to kernel B. Ask research if existing compiled kernels support that.

Links & refs
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PLATFORM/kv-cache-optim (notes + older experiments)
- JIRA: JIRA-4521 (ded-01 driver mismatch)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/789

End of notes.

(Reminder: keep this informal. Move finalized items to a proper doc under shared_drives/engineering/ when ready.)
